mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.phonenumber IS NULL OR TRIM(u.phonenumber) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phonenumber) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(u.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phonenumber, 4)) ELSE '***' END
mapper.select: SELECT rna.id AS application_id, rna.user_id, u.nick_name AS nickname, AS phone_masked, rna.status, rna.real_name_mask AS real_name_masked, rna.id_number_mask AS id_number_masked, rna.material_ref AS material_ref, rna.reject_reason, au.nick_name AS reviewer_name, rna.create_time AS submitted_at, rna.audited_at AS reviewed_at FROM user_real_name_auth rna JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rna.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.user_id = rna.auditor_id WHERE rna.id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT rna.status FROM user_real_name_auth rna WHERE rna.id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_real_name_auth rna SET rna.status = #{status}, rna.auditor_id = #{auditorId}, rna.audited_at = NOW(), rna.reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, rna.update_time = NOW() WHERE rna.id = #{applicationId} AND rna.status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_real_name_auth rna WHERE rna.user_id = #{userId} AND rna.status = 'PENDING'
